general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: End the call right after your closing line, the callback goodbye, the EXIT line, or when they say goodbye. Never before a save_lead you started has returned.

general_tools.name: note_details
general_tools.description: Silently record what they have told you. Call once name, business, industry and operations are all in their own words, right before the reveal. If the result lists anything missing or not recorded, ask for it and call again; reveal only after it comes back complete.

name.description: Their name exactly as they said it.

name_evidence.description: Their own words where they gave the name, verbatim, 2-12 words.

business.description: Business name as they said it.

business_evidence.description: Their own words for the business, verbatim, 2-12 words.

industry.description: Specific industry as they described it. A vague answer is not an industry.

industry_evidence.description: Their own words for the industry, verbatim, 2-12 words.

operations.description: How leads come in and what happens to them today, in their terms.

operations_evidence.description: Their own words about their operations, verbatim, 2-12 words.

general_tools.name: save_lead
general_tools.description: Record the visitor on the OmniSuite waitlist. Stage "final" after they answer the WRAP question and you hold name, email, business, industry and operations. Stage "callback" once you have a name and a number after they asked to be called back. Pass every detail you hold, not only new ones.

stage.description: final = sign-up after the wrap answer; callback = they asked to be called back.

name.description: Their name exactly as they said it.

name_evidence.description: Their own words where they gave the name, verbatim, 2-12 words.

email.description: Email exactly as confirmed, e.g. jo@acme.com. Empty if not given.

phone.description: Phone digits as confirmed, or "skipped" if they passed. Empty if not asked.

business.description: Business name as they said it.

business_evidence.description: Their own words for the business, verbatim, 2-12 words.

industry.description: Specific industry as they described it. A vague answer is not an industry.

industry_evidence.description: Their own words for the industry, verbatim, 2-12 words.

operations.description: How leads come in and what happens to them today, in their terms.

operations_evidence.description: Their own words about their operations, verbatim, 2-12 words.

callback_requested.description: True only if they asked to be called back instead of finishing now.
